categories.main_business_segments: Huapengfei Co., Ltd. primarily operates in comprehensive modern logistics services, focusing on contract logistics and supply chain management. The company offers standardized, one-stop global logistics services and customized supply chain solutions mainly for manufacturing clients and import-export trade entities. Key segments include domestic integrated logistics services, international logistics services, supply chain business, and intelligent mobile services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages integrated logistics operations combining road transport, rail, sea, air, and multimodal transport. It employs digital and intelligent dispatching systems, GPS/Beidou tracking for full-chain risk control, and modern warehouse management. Huapengfei also develops proprietary large logistics systems to integrate domestic and international logistics and supply chain operations, enhancing digitalization and transparency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Huapengfei serves manufacturing enterprises, import-export traders, and industries requiring high-value logistics solutions such as new energy, new materials, and high-end equipment sectors. Its international logistics business focuses on cross-border transport along China-Europe and Central Asia routes, serving markets in Central Asia, Russia, and Europe. The company also targets specialized supply chain segments like fresh produce, equipment manufacturing, and apparel.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant revenue from South China, East China, Southwest, Central China, North China, Northeast, and Northwest regions. Internationally, it has established operations in key logistics nodes such as Horgos, Alashankou, and Kazakhstan, with subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Kazakhstan, focusing on cross-border logistics along the Belt and Road Initiative corridors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huapengfei operates primarily as a midstream and downstream logistics service provider, offering contract logistics, warehousing, transportation, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery. It integrates upstream transportation resources through outsourcing and partnerships but focuses on providing end-to-end supply chain solutions and value-added services to clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes digital transformation and intelligent logistics, investing in the development of a large logistics system to unify domestic and international operations. It focuses on cost control, process optimization, and technology-driven efficiency improvements. Strategic priorities include expanding international logistics capabilities, especially along Belt and Road routes, and deepening service integration with manufacturing clients in high-growth sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Huapengfei generates revenue mainly through service fees from logistics operations including transportation, warehousing, customs brokerage, and supply chain management. Revenue streams include domestic integrated logistics services, international logistics services, supply chain business, and intelligent mobile services. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading contract logistics and supply chain management provider in China, with competitive advantages in integrated multi-modal transport and customized supply chain solutions. It faces competition from domestic logistics firms and international logistics companies entering the Chinese market, which intensifies competition in service quality, cost control, and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Huapengfei reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 334.3 million, a 7.66% decrease from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 17.14 million, down 82.65%. Adjusted for divestitures, revenue showed a 25.26% increase. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.12 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 918.87 million. It experienced fluctuations due to business restructuring but maintains a stable asset base and is focusing on growth in international logistics.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huapengfei emphasizes stable, efficient, and secure logistics services with a comprehensive global transport network. Its differentiation lies in customized, integrated supply chain solutions tailored to manufacturing clients' specific needs, leveraging digital technologies and multi-modal transport integration. The company’s strong capital base supports reliable supplier payments, enhancing operational stability and customer loyalty.
